title: Make the page usable at real scale
notes: On 2026-11-06 a workspace over 100 repositories gave 5,471 cards: the page rendered every card (293,880 px tall), titles showed raw Markdown such as `**UX / UI:**`, and the owner judged the design not good enough. A ChatGPT redesign proposal is under review in `.codeality-ui/propose/2026-11-06-0110/`.

Then redesign `tadu/board/` to it, rendering inline Markdown as text styling.
result: Direction 1 of the ChatGPT redesign shipped; the board binds a stable per-workspace port and keeps saved views per workspace.
